conclusions: L4 is the first member of the frozen L2/L3/L4/L6 ladder that crosses both blind groundwater comparator vectors.
L6 improves the continuous groundwater and profile errors further but does not cross the FMC full-profile vector.
Dimension 4 is therefore a bounded groundwater-frontier result, not an application-independent minimum representation.
The next uncertainty is temporal persistence and reversal behavior, not another storage-only closure search.
